# HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Policy Guidelines

## 1. Initial Waiting Period
All medical conditions require an initial waiting period of 30 days from the policy inception date, except accidental trauma requiring immediate in-patient hospitalization.

## 2. Specified Illnesses & Joint Replacement Waiting Period
A waiting period of 24 months applies for designated surgeries and treatments, including knee replacement, hip replacement, gall bladder stones, kidney calculi, and degenerative joint conditions.

## 3. Pre-Existing Conditions Waiting Period
Pre-existing ailments are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage without break.

## 4. Cashless Network Empanelment
Cashless facility is available across all network partner hospitals. Pre-authorization forms must be submitted with doctor prescription, diagnostic reports, and estimation letter. In-network cashless decisions are communicated within 2 hours.

## 5. Room Rent Eligibility
No capping or proportionate deductions on standard room rent across all sum insured tiers under Optima Secure. The insured is eligible for single private AC rooms.

## 6. Claim Settlement and Grievance Escalation
Reimbursement claims must be submitted within 15 days of discharge. If an initial claim is rejected for query deficiency, complete medical records can be resubmitted within 45 days before escalating to the Insurance Ombudsman.
